title: Execution Approvals
description: Review and manage agent requests for command execution.
emptyDescription: All execution requests have been resolved or none have been submitted.

confirmAllowOnce.title: Allow Execution
confirmAllowOnce.description:
Are you sure you want to allow {{agentId}} to execute this command once? 
{{command}}

confirmAllowAlways.title: Allow Always
confirmAllowAlways.description:
Are you sure you want to ALWAYS allow this exact command? 
{{command}}
This will be added to the allowlist in system configuration.

confirmDeny.title: Deny Execution
confirmDeny.description:
Are you sure you want to deny {{agentId}} from executing this command? 
{{command}}

toast.approvedOnce: The command was approved for a single execution.
toast.approvedAlways: The command was approved and added to the global allowlist.
toast.deniedDesc: The agent was blocked from executing the command.
